purpose: D1 acknowledgement ledger for the cross-database provenance producer-set diff.
rules: A difference is not a defect -- but it must be an EXPLAINED difference, not an unnoticed one.
Every entry needs a verdict from {legitimate, unexplained, unwired} AND a non-empty reason. The detector rejects an entry missing either.
verdict=legitimate SILENCES the row. verdict=unexplained/unwired keeps it RENDERING as a known, tracked difference -- acknowledging is not the same as silencing.
A new, unacknowledged difference fails the run. That is the whole point.

synonyms.reason: One OM extraction pipeline, two labels: gov property_financials stamps `om_extraction`, dia stamps `om_intake`. Same producer (api/_shared/intake-om-pipeline.js). Folding it here stops the diff reporting one producer as two one-sided ones.

The same recorded-owner -> true-owner resolver, labelled with each domain's own connectivity ROUND number (dia ran it at connectivity2, gov at connectivity4). The generation number is not a different producer.

out_of_scope.reason: `source` holds the RUNNER, not a data producer: script names (`pipeline_runner.py`), dataset filenames (`frpp_fy2024.xlsx`) and even temp paths (`/tmp/tmpuab4ll9g.json`), across ~41 buckets on gov alone. It is a data value at modest cardinality, so MAX_PRODUCER_CARDINALITY does not catch it. Diffing it answers 'which scripts has each domain run', which is a real question but not this one.

`source` holds the TARGET TABLE being ingested (`properties`, `sales_transactions`), not the producer. Diffing it compares which tables each domain has ingested into, which the catalogue already answers directly.

`source` holds the emitting CRON JOB name (`lcc-gov-sales-dedup-tick`, `monthly-gsa-diff`). Cron rosters differ per domain by design and are governed by the cron-health surface, not by provenance coherence.

`source_name` holds the candidate ENTITY NAME -- 1,276 distinct values on gov. Caught by MAX_PRODUCER_CARDINALITY as well, and named here so the exclusion is a recorded decision rather than a threshold accident.
